scope: Four new truths; short distances test mechanics, not an observational PTA or SBC.
notes: No posterior truth selected from quadrature nodes.
Mass target is continuous; finite-node positive density interpolation is an integration approximation requiring refinement.
Gaussian controls share latent normals with the physical draw and have exactly the declared Gaussian marginal; no independent PTA segments invented.
Mass=0 fixed-truth coverage is a separate future experiment; a continuous prior places no point probability at zero.
The prior support u<=1 preserves all four travelling-wave Fourier channels.
The sixteen preparatory datasets are not reused as SBC500 repetitions.
Data and posterior calculations use different ORF mechanisms: directly checked nodes versus separately validated interpolation.
Posterior execution settings and its numerical approval are recorded separately.
Pseudorandom draws use NumPy default_rng/PCG64 with the pinned NumPy version.
